SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MIDDLESEX COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 25002345
DOCKET NO. F01292224
PLAINTIFF – WELLS FARGO BANK, NATIONAL ASSOCIATION AS TRUSTEE FOR SOUNDVIEW HOME LOAN TRUST 2007-OPT1, ASSET-BACKED CERTIFICATES, SERIES 2007-OPT1
DEFENDANTS- RICHARD VALENTINE, ET ALS.
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Wednesday THE 7th DAY OF October 2026
between the hours of twelve and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 1:30 P.M. prevailing time at The Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston Avenue, New Brunswick, New Jersey 08901 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the TOWNSHIP OF NORTH BRUNSWICK, County of Middlesex and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 60 BLOCK 262
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
845 HOOVER DRIVE NORTH BRUNSWICK, NJ 08902
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Middlesex County Clerk.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
PROPERTY TO BE SOLD IS LOCATED IN: Township of North Brunswick, County of Middlesex, in the State of New Jersey
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS: 845 Hoover Dr, North Brunswick, NJ 08902
TAX LOT # 60 Block # 262 NEAREST CROSS STREET: Hillside Drive
APPROXIMATE DIMENSIONS: 118’ x 228'
A full legal description can be found at the Office of the Register
Taxes and Other Encumbrances:
3rd Quarter of 2026 taxes due in the amount of $4,478.23
Water open balance in the amount of $177.78, good through August 1, 2026
Sewer open balance in the amount of $251.55, good through August 1, 2026
Other open balance in the amount of $27.33, good through August 1, 2026
Plus interest on these figures through date of payoff and any and all subsequent taxes, water and sewer amounts.
Upset Price: $708,414.92, good through December 31, 2026, and any additional sums as ordered by the court.
Occupancy Status: Occupancy status at the property is unknown.
THIS SALE IS SUBJECT TO THE RIGHT OF REDEMPTION OF THE FEDERAL GOVERNMENT
SUBJECT TO ADDITIONAL ADVANCES MADE BY PLAINTIFF FOR TAXES, INSURANCE, INSPECTIONS, ETC., AFTER FINAL JUDGMENT WAS ENTERED. THE AMOUNT ADVANCED WAS $17,687.43 AND THE PLAINTIFF HAS OBTAINED AN ORDER TO BE REIMBURSED FOR THESE MONIES OR TO MAKE FIRST CLAIM FOR ANY SURPLUS MONIES REALIZED FROM THIS SALE.
SUBJECT TO THE CONDITIONS OF SALE AS SET FORTH BY THE SHERIFF WHO RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THE SALE WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE THROUGH PUBLICATION
SUBJECT TO: SUCH FACTS AS AN ACCURATE SURVEY AND PHYSICAL INSPECTION OF THE PREMISES MAY REVEAL, EASEMENTS AND RESTRICTIONS OF RECORD, IF ANY; UNPAID TAXES, ASSESSMENTS, WATER AND SEWER LIENS, IF ANY; RIGHTS OF TENANTS AND OCCUPANTS, IF ANY; STATE AND MUNICIPAL ORDINANCES, STATUTES & REGULATIONS, INCLUDING ZONING ORDINANCE; ANY OUTSTANDING TAXES, WATER AND SEWER WITH INTEREST THROUGH THE DATE OF PAYOFF; IF THE SALE IS SET ASIDE FOR ANY REASON, THE PURCHASER AT THE SALE SHALL BE ENTITLED ONLY TO A RETURN OF THE DEPOSIT PAID. THE PURCHASER SHALL HAVE NO FURTHER RECOURSE, INCLUDING ANY COSTS AND EXPENSES, INCLUDING ATTONRNEYS’ FEES, FOR BIDDING UPON THE PROPERTY, AGAINST THE MORTGAGEE, OR THE MORTGAGEE’S ATTORNEY; THE OUTSTANDING TAXES, LIENS AND/ OR ENCUMBRANCES DISCLOSED IN THIS PUBLICATION ARE ACCURATE AS OF THE DATE OF SUBMISSION TO THE SHERIFF ONLY. IT IS THE RESPONSIBILITY OF ANY POTENCIAL BIDDER AT SALE TO DETERMINE THE AMOUNT DUE, WHICH CAN BE OBTAINED FROM THE LOCAL TAXING AUTHORITY. PLAINTIFFF HAS NO OBLIGATION TO FURTHER INVESTIGATE, PUBLISH OR ANNOUNCE ANY SUBSEQUENTLY ACCRUING TAXES, LIENS AND/ OR ENCUMBRANCE. THIRD PARTY BEDDERS EXPRESSLY AGREE & RECOGNIZE THAT THEY WILL TAKE TITLE SUBJECT TO THE EXISTENCE OF ANY SUBSEQUENTLY ACCRUING TAXES, LIENS AND/OR ENCUMBRANCES AND ABSOLUTELY AND UNEQUIVOCALLY RELEASE ANY RIGHT TO CHALLENGE THE VALIDITY OF THE SALE
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Middlesex County Clerk’s Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remains of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $617,434.51 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration, are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
MILDRED S. SCOTT
SHERIFF
DATED: August 5, 2026
STERN & EISENBERG P.C.
1120 ROUTE 73 SUITE 400
MOUNT LAUREL, NJ 08054
(609) 397-9200
